title: Forbidden Portals
description: The journey is just as important as the destination. Explore the Nether and the End, where epic battles await, and prove your worth by defeating the Warden and the Wither!
body:
Modern Minecraft often overlooks the dangers of the Overworld in favor of quick resources from the Nether and the End. Forbidden Portals changes that dynamic by sealing the dimensional portals. To cross them, you don’t just need resources; you need victory.

Key Features:
The Sealed Nether Portal: Access to the Nether is forbidden until the Warden is defeated. Feel the true fear of the depths before facing the fire.
 
The Blocked End: The End portal will remain inactive for you until the Wither falls in combat. Endgame now demands elite preparation.

Immersive Repulsion System: When attempting to enter a portal without meeting the requirements, you will be repelled with an “Access Denied” message, ensuring no one accidentally “skips steps.”
